title: Graffiti Girl with Spray Can
description: A stylized female character with voluminous, spiky magenta-red hair stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a red crop top, red shorts, a red cape, a tool belt, and tall red platform boots while holding a silver spray can in her right hand.
prompt: A fierce young woman with enormous, wild spiky magenta and red hair stands in a dynamic contrapposto pose against a plain dark gray background. She has sharp facial features and is wearing a red leather crop top, red shorts, a small red cape with gold trim, a black utility belt, and tall red platform combat boots. She holds a silver spray paint can in her right hand and gestures with her left. Cartoonish yet detailed digital painting style with vibrant colors and clean shading.
